requirements.requirement: The system must compute a completeness score based on the proportion of required data fields that are present versus missing.
The system must normalize the completeness score to a 0–1 scale.
The system must compute a recency score based on the age of the underlying data relative to a defined freshness threshold.
The system must normalize the recency score to a 0–1 scale where more recent data yields higher values.
The system must compute an agreement score based on variance or dispersion across contributing quality measures.
The system must normalize the agreement score to a 0–1 scale where lower variance yields higher agreement.
The system must combine completeness, recency, and agreement scores into a single confidence score using a deterministic formula.
The system must ensure the final confidence score is normalized to a 0–1 scale.
The system must produce identical confidence scores when given identical input data (deterministic behavior).
The system must handle missing optional data fields without failing and adjust the completeness score accordingly.
The system must return a confidence score of 0 when all required data fields are missing.
The system must degrade the recency score when data age exceeds the defined freshness threshold.
The system must handle invalid or non-numeric measure inputs by excluding them from agreement calculation and logging the event.
The system must return a valid confidence score even when only one component (completeness, recency, or agreement) is available.
The system must ensure the confidence calculation executes within acceptable performance bounds for synchronous API usage.
